resources.string: Keeps your remote\'s extra buttons working. remapd starts by itself after a restart, and whenever you open this app.

One-time setup, with a computer:
1. On the computer, run: adb tcpip 5555
2. Select Set up. When the TV asks "Allow USB debugging?", tick "Always allow from this computer" and select Allow.

The app then lets itself switch wireless debugging on and off, turns off adb's 7-day authorization timeout (for every key) so its key keeps working, exempts itself from battery restrictions, closes port 5555 and puts remapd in /data/local/tmp (starting it, if you've set up buttons before). Finally it turns wireless debugging off: it switches it on by itself when it needs it. After that, set up your buttons with Buttons.
Starts after a restart: not set up yet.
remapd: not detected. Select Check status to make sure.
remapd isn\'t in /data/local/tmp yet. Select Buttons, which puts it there.
There\'s no /data/local/tmp/remapd.conf yet. Select Buttons to set up your buttons.
On the TV, tick \"Always allow from this computer\" and select Allow.\nThe key fingerprint it shows should be %1$s
Starting remapd the way it will start after a restart…
On the TV, allow wireless debugging on this network (tick Always allow).
Port 5555 may still be open. Run adb usb on your computer to close it (it also closes at the next restart).
Wireless debugging is off now. The app switches it on by itself when it needs it; turn it back on in Developer options when you want to use adb from your computer.
Couldn\'t turn off adb\'s authorization timeout, so the TV will forget the app\'s key 7 days after setup. Turn on \"Disable adb authorization timeout\" in Developer options.
Couldn\'t exempt the app from all of Android\'s background limits, so starting remapd after a restart may be delayed.
remapd hasn\'t been started from here yet.
Not set up yet. Select Set up.
USB debugging is off. Turn it on in Developer options; remapd stops without it.
The TV isn\'t on Wi-Fi, and wireless debugging only works over Wi-Fi.
Wireless debugging wasn\'t allowed on this Wi-Fi access point yet (a dual-band or mesh router has several). Allow it when the TV asks, ticking Always allow; the app then starts remapd by itself.
Couldn\'t find wireless debugging on the network.
The TV no longer accepts this app\'s key (maybe USB debugging authorizations were revoked). Run adb tcpip 5555 on your computer and select Set up again.
Nothing answered on port 5555. Run adb tcpip 5555 on your computer first, then select Set up.
The TV didn\'t allow the connection. Select Set up again, then allow it (tick Always allow).
The TV allowed the connection just this once, so it didn\'t save the app\'s key. Run adb tcpip 5555 on your computer again, select Set up again, and tick \"Always allow from this computer\".
Couldn\'t give the app the permission it needs: %1$s
Couldn\'t read the app\'s key (%1$s). Select Set up again.

Select Add a button, then press the button on your remote; while the app listens, remapd holds on to the TV\'s input devices, so the press doesn\'t do anything on the TV. Select a button in the list to change it. Changes go into /data/local/tmp/remapd.conf (the previous one is kept as remapd.conf.bak) and remapd restarts with them. Wireless debugging stays on while this screen is open.
Couldn\'t put remapd in /data/local/tmp, so buttons can\'t be set up yet:
